address: Lot 1-01, 1F, Menara Hap Seng 3, Jalan P. Ramlee, Kuala Lumpur, 50250, Malaysia
bio: Skillet sports a wine cellar and a lounge for drinks before or after your meal. The tasteful venue is adorned in striking dried flower arrangements depicting the seasons, just like the season-driven menu which showcases exquisite dishes underpinned by solid European techniques and sometimes stars local ingredients. Try dried longan bread and ramson-flavoured angel hair pasta. The set lunch menu is a bargain....
